prompt: Users can now choose to get alerts by SMS instead of email; store the choice in a new `User.channel` field, "email" or "sms". Texts go through `SmsGateway.send` in alerts/gateways.py, and `build_service` in alerts/app.py already receives the gateway. Wire it up. A user who chose texts but has no phone number should still get the alert by email.
Users can also choose `push`: notifications to the app go through `PushGateway.send(device_token, text)` in alerts/gateways.py, and `build_service` already receives that gateway too. Wire it up.
